rituals.ritualText:
GAME
REHEARSE THE ROAD, NOT THE TROPHY

GOAL
Visualising the finish can feel productive while leaving Step 1 homeless.

ONE RULE
What changes when you imagine three minutes of the process instead of celebrating the result?

PLAY
Close your eyes and mentally rehearse only the first three concrete actions, including one likely friction point.

TWIST
Spot whether the next physical move becomes easier to identify.

WIN
Process-focused mental simulation can support planning and action more than outcome fantasy alone.

MIND BEND
The finish line motivates; the road tells your body what to do.

SAFETY
Use this for a small, reversible next step. Do not let momentum override pain, exhaustion, safety or consequences that need proper thought. Only do eyes-closed steps while seated or safely stationary—never while driving, walking or moving.
rituals.target_pattern: Outcome fantasy leaving the first actions underspecified
rituals.theory_backbone: Process simulation; mental imagery; goal pursuit
rituals.mechanism_fingerprint: Replace outcome-only fantasy with a short sequential simulation of the first concrete actions and one anticipated obstacle.
